snippet.title: Trenches VR - Official Announcement Trailer | Upload VR Showcase 2025
snippet.description: Explore the tense and twisted world of Trenches in VR. Check out the Trenches VR announcement trailer for this World War 1 horror survival game. Trenches VR will be available on Steam VR, PS VR2 (PlayStation VR2), and Meta Quest in 2025.
